market.name: WXTZ/USDC Etherlink Mainnet First Market
market.loanTokenNote: Bridge-minted WrappedERC20, NOT Circle-native USDC. Mint/burn are onlyBridge against an immutable bridge at 0x1f8e735f424b7a49a885571a2fa104e8c13c26c7. No pause, no blacklist, no permit, no mint cap.
market.collateralTokenNote: LayerZero OFT and native XTZ wrapper. lzReceive mints locally. sharedDecimals 6, decimalConversionRate 1e12, setPeer behind a 48h TIMELOCK.
market.oracleScaleDerivation: 36 + loanDecimals(6) - collateralDecimals(18) = 24. At ~0.2069 USDC per WXTZ, price() must return approximately 2.069e23.
market.irmNote: Frozen by ADR 0003 as the single in-scope IRM. Address recorded after deployment.
market.lltvNote: Proposed in config/risk/wxtz-usdc-market-risk-memo.md. Liquidation incentive at this LLTV is 12.68%. Enabling an LLTV is PERMANENT: Morpho has no disableLltv.

risk.capsEnforcementNote: CRITICAL: Morpho Blue core has NO supply or borrow cap. Verified against the pinned source: supply() has no cap check and the string 'cap' does not appear in Morpho.sol. ADR 0003 excludes any MetaMorpho vault layer, so no on-chain cap mechanism exists in the frozen scope. Every cap below is an ADVISORY MONITORING THRESHOLD, not an enforced limit. Anyone can supply or borrow past these values and we cannot stop them.
risk.capMeasuredQuantityNote: The WXTZ figures below are COLLATERAL exposure, i.e. the sum of position collateral entering via supplyCollateral(), denominated in WXTZ at 18 decimals. They are NOT Morpho supply() amounts: supply() supplies the LOAN token, which is USDC at 6 decimals. A monitor that compares these 18-decimal WXTZ values against loan-supply accounting will never fire. Monitor total market collateral for the WXTZ figures and total supplied/borrowed USDC for the USDC figure.
risk.advisoryInitialCollateralCapHuman: 25,000 WXTZ collateral (~$5,173) - monitor total supplyCollateral exposure
risk.advisoryMaxCollateralCapHuman: 30,000 WXTZ collateral, reachable only after the cap ratchet in the risk memo
risk.hardStopCollateralHuman: 35,000 WXTZ collateral. Conservative stop; note the 30,000-40,000 band is unmeasured, see liquidationLiquidityNotes.
risk.liquidationLiquidityNotes: Measured on KyberSwap at block ~49494673 on 2026-07-27. Flat to ~25,000 WXTZ at 0.51% slippage; 30,000 WXTZ at 2.25%; 40,000 WXTZ at 21.06%; above 40,000 the absolute USDC output falls. MEASUREMENT GAP: nothing was sampled between 30,000 and 40,000, so the boundary is bounded by measurement, not located by it. Calm-market measurement; stressed conditions will be worse. One aggregator only - re-measure on a second router before approval.
knownAssetRisks: Executable depth caps the entire market at low five figures USD. A SINGLE liquidation of 40,000 WXTZ is confirmed unprofitable (21.06% slippage vs a 12.68% incentive at LLTV 0.625). 30,000 WXTZ is confirmed viable at 2.25%. The boundary between them is not measured. Morpho also permits partial liquidation, so a large position can be cleared in profitable slices provided the pool replenishes between them - see the WXTZ due diligence for why that is a weaker guarantee than it sounds.

A single 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe (0x90481dadc7163d984c4939691c113617fa27c383) owns WXTZ and owns the bridge that mints USDC. One trust root for both sides of this market. Isolated markets do not mitigate a dependency shared inside one market.
The USDC bridge has unlimited uncapped mint authority. setTrustedRemote shows no timelock, unlike WXTZ setPeer which has 48h.
WXTZ is a LayerZero OFT: lzReceive mints locally, so a compromised peer can mint WXTZ not backed by newly locked XTZ.
Neither token has a pause or blacklist, and Morpho has no pause. In an incident essentially nothing on-chain can be stopped.
Market creation and supply are permissionless. Third parties can create lookalike WXTZ/USDC markets with a different oracle, and can supply past the advisory caps.
Pyth USDC/USD prices Circle USDC, not this bridged wrapper. Using it assumes bridged-USDC equals Circle-USDC, which is exactly the assumption that fails during a bridge incident.

blockers: Finding 0: caps are not enforceable on-chain in the frozen scope. Risk owner must decide: launch uncapped and monitor, add a vault layer via a new ADR, or delay.
LLTV 0.625 is proposed, not approved. Enabling it is permanent.
Oracle not selected. Phase 3 owns this. Required output scale is 1e24 for this decimal pair.
Both assets are recorded NOT APPROVED in their due-diligence files pending risk-owner decisions.
Provenance not cited for the WXTZ address, the USDC address, or the bridge.
Depth measured on one aggregator only.
No liquidation has been rehearsed on Shadownet.
Shared 2-of-3 multisig trust root not explicitly accepted in writing.
